purpose: 0.4.1 integration acceptance/reproduction matrix. GUARDED means a source/runtime invariant now protects the failure class; MANUAL means the implementation exists but world/UX behavior still needs an in-game acceptance pass; KNOWN_DEBT is reserved for unresolved behavior.

cases.expected: Walking inside target radius while outside every generated structure piece does not complete the objective.
repro: Accept a surface structure survey and approach only the configured radius.
Remain outside the visible/generated structure and wait through the completion poll.

cases.expected: Standing on the surface above underground target X/Z never completes the survey.
repro: Accept an underground survey and stand at target X/Z on the surface.
Wait through the completion poll and inspect objective state.

cases.expected: Empty volume inside a huge StructureStart box is not meaningful occupancy.
repro: Use a large multi-piece structure with air gaps.
Stand inside the whole-start box but outside actual pieces and inspect completion.

cases.expected: Another instance of the same structure ID cannot complete the assigned instance.
repro: Accept a contract with an exact start-chunk identity.
Enter another instance of the same structure ID and inspect completion.

cases.expected: A locator outside the real box remains navigable without fabricating a wrong instance identity.
repro: Use a modded structure whose locate point lies outside its generated box.
Accept the contract, inspect stored identity, then enter the real structure.

cases.expected: Completion uses occupied structure pieces/discovery rather than whole-start box alone.
repro: Generate a multi-piece structure with empty space inside its aggregate box.
Stand only in the empty aggregate space and inspect completion.

cases.expected: Resolution does not force arbitrary remote chunk generation merely to prove occupancy.
repro: Use a structure family that has not yet been generated/indexed near a village.
Interact with quest-capable residents and verify the offer path does not generate remote chunks to invent a target.

cases.expected: Evidence is not granted merely by structure occupancy; a physical cache interaction is required.
repro: Accept a recovery contract and enter the assigned structure without opening the evidence source.
Inspect inventory and objective state.

cases.expected: A contract cannot leave multiple valid evidence objects after replacement/recovery.
repro: Recover evidence, drop it, and exercise the replacement path.
Collect both old and replacement evidence and attempt turn-in.

cases.expected: Renamed/lookalike items cannot satisfy evidence matching.
repro: Rename an arbitrary item to the recovery display name.
Attempt turn-in with only the fake item.

cases.expected: Full inventory/cache conditions have a safe understandable evidence path with no silent inventory mint or loss.
repro: Fill the player inventory and the opened target cache before the evidence interaction.
Verify the runtime asks for cache space rather than silently awarding or deleting the evidence.

cases.expected: Active recovery state survives death/relog and remains recoverable.
repro: Accept a recovery contract and make partial progress.
Die or relog, then verify quest/village/target binding remains correct.

cases.expected: Evidence from quest A cannot turn in quest B.
repro: Hold evidence for recovery quest A.
Attempt turn-in for recovery quest B.

cases.expected: Evidence from village A cannot turn in the same quest for village B.
repro: Obtain evidence for village A and activate equivalent work in village B.
Attempt village B turn-in with village A evidence.

cases.expected: Successful turn-in consumes the matching evidence.
repro: Obtain valid evidence and turn in successfully.
Inspect inventory for the consumed item.

cases.expected: Recovery contracts from different villages remain independently bound.
repro: Accept recovery work from villages A and B.
Complete one and verify the other remains active and unchanged.

cases.expected: RUMOR gives rough guidance and never an exact Atlas pin.
repro: Obtain only RUMOR-level information for a target.
Open the Atlas and verify no exact target marker was added.

cases.expected: A KNOWN target can be marked by an authorized knowledgeable source.
repro: Advance a target to KNOWN through a valid specialist/record.
Request marking and verify the intended Atlas marker appears.

cases.expected: Markers use useful approach/entrance positions, not hostile objective centers.
repro: Use a target with hazardous interior geometry.
Request an Atlas marker and compare it with the real generated approach.

cases.expected: Underground KNOWN markers identify a surface structure edge/approach rather than the chamber center.
repro: Advance an underground target to KNOWN.
Request a marker and compare it to the structure edge nearest the issuing village.

cases.expected: Gore discovery requires meaningful tunnel-piece presence and marks a surface approach rather than the lair center.
repro: Obtain a Tunnel Gore lead and approach only the broad locator/bounding area.
Verify CONFIRMED waits for exact-piece dwell, then inspect whether the surface approach is actually useful in this generated instance.

cases.expected: An adult jobless village still exposes multiple civic/adventure surfaces without mutating vanilla trade professions.
repro: Use a village whose adult residents have not claimed trade professions.
Interact with several adults and count useful starter/referral surfaces.

cases.expected: A tiny surviving village retains a public/civic progression fallback.
repro: Reduce a village to one or two adult survivors.
Verify at least one useful progression route remains.

cases.expected: Death of all profession-specific givers cannot softlock village-owned work.
repro: Start or unlock profession-owned work.
Remove all eligible profession holders and verify successor/civic fallback.

cases.expected: Nearby settlements retain distinct keys, actives, hints, standing and completions.
repro: Use two villages within roughly 100-150 blocks, especially ones with separate meeting POIs.
Accept work in one and inspect routing/state ownership in the other; also exercise the rare unnamed fallback path if possible.

cases.expected: Referral selection rejects villagers from a different village key.
repro: Accept a structure quest in village A near village B.
Ask for a specialist and verify the selected villager belongs to A.

cases.expected: Wrong-villager clicks still surface useful routing for critical state.
repro: Activate or unlock a critical village state.
Click an irrelevant adult and verify useful routing rather than a dead end.

cases.expected: Completed objectives suppress active-task hints.
repro: Complete an active objective.
Click former hint/referral villagers and verify stale active hints are gone.

cases.expected: A bounded five-family recent history suppresses identical semantic hint spam while preserving profession-first voice.
repro: Ask at least five eligible villagers about one active target.
Record selected hint families and verify recently used families are down-ranked until the appropriate candidate pool is exhausted.

cases.expected: A just-used structure instance is down-weighted for unrelated follow-up offers.
repro: Complete an authored structure quest.
Immediately seek the next authored offer and inspect selected instance.

cases.expected: Primary reward archetype is down-weighted back-to-back without authored reason.
repro: Record the primary reward family of a completed quest.
Inspect the next authored reward family for the same village/chapter.

cases.expected: Visible quest pool has no more than two quests with the same core verb.
repro: Enumerate currently visible/eligible offers.
Normalize primary verbs and verify no verb appears more than twice.

cases.expected: One-time authored problems do not immediately recycle.
repro: Complete an authored one-time quest.
Return to the same village/profession and verify it is not offered again.

cases.expected: Action-bar text is a short transient state/route confirmation rather than a sentence-sized NPC speech surface.
repro: Trigger survey, recovery, hint and referral action-bar messages.
Verify explanatory prose is absent and compact dynamic routes remain readable at normal GUI scale.

cases.expected: NPC explanation/referral context remains in Conversations; runtime-only names/bearings appear only as compact data confirmations.
repro: Choose a Conversations reply asking for directions or a hint.
Verify the semantic NPC response stays in Conversations and any HUD follow-up is terse data rather than another speech paragraph.

cases.expected: Conversation beats stay under the hard QA ceiling and near the short-beat target.
repro: Run the static Conversations QA validator.
Inspect warnings above 30 words and split genuine prose walls.

cases.expected: Authored offer stems provide active and turn-in state coverage.
repro: Enumerate authored *_offer.json stems.
Verify corresponding active/turn-in states are present or explicitly surfaced as debt.

cases.expected: Ordinary villager interaction cannot enter Minecraft's synchronous broad structure-locate API.
repro: Enter a newly generated/indexed village and interact with structure-quest-capable residents.
Profile/search the quest runtime and verify target selection uses GeneratedStructureIndexSavedData rather than findNearestMapStructure.

cases.expected: Authored structure selection is a bounded search over the persistent generated-start index; accepted exact targets remain persisted and no expensive worldgen-locate cache boundary exists on click.
repro: Resolve one target repeatedly in the same village and from a second village/cell.
Verify all target lookup stays inside GeneratedStructureIndexSavedData and does not trigger synchronous worldgen locate work.

cases.expected: Watchdog triage uses the actual Server thread stack and distinguishes quest locate from teleport/chunk stalls.
repro: Run tools/analyze_watchdog_log.py on a watchdog-containing latest.log.
Confirm classifications are driven by the Server thread stack rather than nearby timestamps.
